description_ru: Юмористический рассказ о соседском попугае, который копирует звонки, грубит почтальону и в итоге начинает ходить в гости.
text:
My neighbour, Mr Hodges, has a parrot called Captain, and he is the rudest bird in the world. He is grey, with a red tail and a loud voice, and he lives on a perch next to an open window. Mr Hodges bought him five years ago, because he wanted a quiet pet. He was very wrong, because Captain never stops talking.

At first, I liked him. When I moved into my flat last spring, Captain said "Hello!" every morning, and I thought that it was friendly. But after a few days I noticed that he knew many other words. Some of them were not polite. Mr Hodges used to work on boats, and he told me that the bird had learned most of his vocabulary on a ship. I do not want to repeat what Captain said to the postman, but the postman does not come to our building any more. Now he leaves the letters at the gate.

The parrot also copies sounds. He can imitate a telephone, a doorbell and a microwave. This is a big problem, because I never know what is real. Last week, I was sitting at my desk, and I heard the doorbell. I ran to open the door, but nobody was there. Then I heard it again. After the third time, I realised that it was Captain. When I looked through my window, he was sitting on his perch and looking at me. I am almost sure that he was laughing.

His best trick is the telephone. Every evening at six o'clock, he rings like my mobile phone, and I take it out of my pocket every time. Once, I was in a very important meeting, and I was sitting at the table with my boss. Captain rang from the street, and I answered the call. "Hello? Hello?" I said. There was only silence. My boss looked at me. "Who is calling?" he asked. "I think it is a bird," I said. He did not smile.

Mr Hodges likes to say that Captain is a clever bird. I agree, but he is clever in the wrong way. He knows exactly when someone is sad or in a hurry, and he chooses that moment to shout. One morning I was late for work. I ran out of the house with my coat in my hand, and Captain shouted, "You are late! Hurry up!" in the voice of my mother. I do not know how he learned it. I think that he listens to my phone calls.

Another day, my girlfriend came to visit me for the first time. She is a very elegant person, and I wanted to make a good impression. We walked past Mr Hodges's window, and Captain said, "Who is this? She is much prettier than the last one." I never had a "last one". I tried to explain this to her, but she was already laughing so much that she could not hear me. I told her that the parrot was lying. Captain answered, "Liar!" and she nearly fell over.

I decided that I had to do something. I bought some nice biscuits for the bird and brought them to Mr Hodges. "I want to make friends with Captain," I explained. The old man was delighted, and he invited me to have tea. Captain sat on his shoulder and watched me carefully with one eye. When I gave him a biscuit, he took it and said, "Thank you." It was the first polite thing I had heard him say. I felt a bit proud.

For two days, everything was peaceful. Then, on Saturday morning, I woke up at six o'clock and heard a voice behind my door. It said, "Good morning, my friend. Open the biscuits!" I went to the window, and I saw Captain on my balcony. He had flown over from Mr Hodges's flat, and he was holding a small piece of paper in his beak. I do not know where he found it. It was my shopping list.

Now Captain visits me every day. He sits on the chair, eats my biscuits and tells me about the news in the building. I have learned a lot about our neighbours. For example, I now know that the woman on the second floor is secretly learning to play the drums. I do not think that Mr Hodges wanted a quiet pet. But I have to say that my life is much more interesting, and I am not alone in the evenings.

focus_sounds.tip_ru: Долгий звук между «э» и «ё», губы нейтральны, язык не двигается.
Лёгкий выдох из горла без напряжения. Это не русское «х».
Кончик языка поднят и не касается нёба, губы чуть округлены. Не раскатывайте русское «р».
В конце слога язык оттягивается назад, звук твёрдый. Не произносите мягкое русское «ль».

questions.question: Where did Captain learn his words?
questions.answer: Mr Hodges worked on boats, and the parrot learned most of his words on a ship.

questions.question: What sounds can Captain imitate?
questions.answer: A telephone, a doorbell and a microwave.

questions.question: What happened in the meeting with the boss?
questions.answer: Captain rang like a phone, and the writer answered it.

questions.question: How did the story end?
questions.answer: Captain now visits the writer's balcony every day, eats biscuits and shares news about neighbours.
